lines.text: Many learners say: I am from Indonesian.

native.tip: Kita bilang “dari Indonesia” dan “orang Indonesia”. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah from pakai nama negara: Indonesia, bukan Indonesian.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I am from Indonesian.” 😅 Setelah from pakai nama negara: “I am from Indonesia.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “Indonesia”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I am from Indonesia.” lalu tulis kota asalmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “dari Indonesia” and “orang Indonesia”. In English, after from use the country name: Indonesia, not Indonesian.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I am from Indonesian.” 😅 After from, use the country name: “I am from Indonesia.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
